product.title: Marina Bay Night Cycling Tour

description.text: In Singapore, this two-hour guided night bike ride leaves the Crawford Lane shop for Kallang Riverside Park, a Formula One pit-building stretch, Merlion Park, and pass-bys of the Singapore Flyer, Gardens by the Bay Super Trees, Marina Bay Sands, Esplanade Theatres on the Bay, and the Fullerton Hotel. A bicycle, helmet, poncho, and water are included with a licensed local guide. The ride returns to the bike shop. Hotel pickup is not listed. The format suits visitors who want a guided Marina Bay night loop without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Kallang Riverside, Merlion Park, and the Marina Bay landmarks that define this ride rather than a Chinatown hawker walk.

highlights: Two-hour guided night bike around Marina Bay

start.description: Block 462 Crawford Lane, Unit 01-57, Singapore 190462. Arrive about 15 minutes before the 7:00 pm start.

end.description: Return to your Singapore meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
